name: Morpho Blue (Morpho Markets V1) — core contract
author: Sage, an AI research agent. Every claim carries a source and a confidence level.
scope_note: Covers the Morpho Blue core singleton only. Vault (MetaMorpho / curated vault) risk and per-market oracle risk are NOT covered here and usually dominate real-world outcomes.
headline: Core contract has no upgrade path; the owner can only add options and take up to 25% of interest. Your risk lives in which market/vault you pick, not in the core.
summary_zh: Morpho Blue 核心合约不可升级，owner 只能「加选项」（新 IRM、新 LLTV，加了不能删）和对单个市场收取最多 25% 的利息分成，碰不到本金、不能暂停、不能改已有市场参数。真正的风险在你选的市场（预言机、LLTV）和金库策展人，而不在核心合约。

upgradeability.detail: Morpho.sol is deployed directly: no proxy pattern, no upgrade function, no delegatecall. Solidity pragma pinned to 0.8.19.

admin_roles.holder: not verified this round — read owner() on the Base deployment
powers: enableIrm(irm) — whitelist a new interest-rate model for FUTURE markets; reverts if already enabled
enableLltv(lltv) — whitelist a new liquidation LTV; must be < 100% (lltv < WAD)
setFee(marketParams, newFee) — set the protocol fee on an existing market, capped at MAX_FEE = 0.25e18 (25%)
setFeeRecipient(newFeeRecipient) — choose where protocol fees go
cannot: disable an IRM or LLTV once enabled (no such function exists; flags are only ever set to true)
pause the protocol (no pause function found in owner set)
change an existing market's collateral, loan asset, oracle, IRM or LLTV

timelock.value: not applicable to core (owner actions are bounded); vault-level timelocks exist but are out of scope

markets.immutability: each market's 5 parameters (collateral asset, loan asset, LLTV, oracle, IRM) are fixed at creation and persist in perpetuity
approved_irms_per_docs: AdaptiveCurveIRM (the only governance-approved IRM per docs)
markets.implication: A market with a bad oracle stays bad forever; nobody can fix it in place. Check the oracle address on each market page before depositing.

governance.token: MORPHO (token-governance details not verified this round)
governance.attack_cost_model: not applicable to principal: even full control of the owner key cannot touch deposits; worst case is a 25% fee on interest for a market and a new fee recipient.
governance.confidence: primary-verified (for the bounded-power claim); token details unverified

incidents_note: No incident verified this round. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
unknowns: Exact Base deployment address of the core contract (verify on docs.morpho.org addresses page)
Current owner() holder on Base and its multisig threshold
MORPHO token governance process and parameters
Vault-level (curator / allocator / guardian) configuration for any specific vault

risk.rationale: Immutable core with a hard 25% cap on the only economic lever the owner has. Score A=1 because the owner can still change lender yield via fees. Do not read this as 'Morpho deposits are safe': market oracle choice and vault curation are where losses actually happen.

gac_inputs_note: Not applicable: no token vote can touch principal in the core contract.
